methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $61.22B (to $118.6B) × margin 22.8% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $47.54B
K = capital to build it: $61.22B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.50 = $40.81B
σ = 91% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $35.54B
assets in place = NOPAT $0 ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $35.54B + net cash $657.0M) ÷ 192,869,271 = $187.69
